assignments.package_label: תּוֹרָה וְיַעֲקֹב — תּוֹרָה, אֱמֶת, רֵאָה, יַעֲקֹב, אָדָם
assignments.reason: This node describes אדם (man) performing the back-and-forth movement in his home, mirroring Elisha's motion when reviving the Shunamite's son. The Torah explicitly identifies אדם as a bechina of תורה ('זאת התורה אדם'), and the movement itself is the lung-wings (ראה/כנפי ראה) fanning — the physical enactment of the Torah/Jacob/Lung cluster. Its essential nature is the Torah-man activating the cooling breath, placing it squarely in Package 1.

assignments.package_label: תּוֹרָה וְיַעֲקֹב — תּוֹרָה, אֱמֶת, רֵאָה, יַעֲקֹב, אָדָם
assignments.reason: Reviving the dead is the ultimate positive outcome of the Torah-man's movement. It is the life-giving power that emerges when the lungs (ראה = תורה = יעקב) successfully cool the fire in the heart. Its essential nature is the triumph of the holiness side — life over death — which is the culminating expression of the Torah/Truth/Lung cluster. No separate package is warranted; it belongs to the good domain of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: מה שאדם, שהוא בחינת תורה, כמו שכתוב (במדבר י"ט): "זאת התורה אדם", נע ונד אפלו בתוך ביתו
assignments.package_label: תּוֹרָה וְיַעֲקֹב — תּוֹרָה, אֱמֶת, רֵאָה, יַעֲקֹב, אָדָם
assignments.reason: This is the expanded form of the cause-node, explicitly naming the bechina chain: אדם = תורה, and the movement (נע ונד) = the lung-wings fanning. The node itself declares its Package 1 identity by citing the verse 'זאת התורה אדם'. Its essential nature is the Torah-man-lung complex in active motion — the core mechanism of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: יכול לשכך את האש שהוא בחינות דינים, ויכול להחיות מתים שיהיו חיים
assignments.package_label: תּוֹרָה וְיַעֲקֹב — תּוֹרָה, אֱמֶת, רֵאָה, יַעֲקֹב, אָדָם
assignments.reason: This compound outcome node describes two results: cooling the fire/dinin and reviving the dead. Although it references אש and דינים (Package 3), the node's essential nature is the positive achievement — the successful cooling and life-restoration accomplished by Torah-power. The fire/dinin are mentioned as the object being overcome, not as the subject. The agent and the triumph belong to the good side, making this a Package 1 node.
